title: Promenade deck — actual geometry, weather roofs and ceilings omitted
staging: Registered fixture points plus photographic fill; atlas emission visible but not sampled as area lights; diffuse/glossy bounces 2/2
diagnostic_limit: True roof-off deck diagnostic: only explicitly named separate weather-roof objects, ceilings, signs and glazing are omitted. Original deck, room walls and every room furniture mesh are retained. Not a photograph, hidden-contact proof or continuous avatar-access certification.
postprocess: Cycles actual source geometry; tiled standalone OIDN 2 CPU, 384px core/80px halo; JPEG94, no resize
